captionStarter: Phillies 7, Rays 3. Philly clinches the last NL Wild Card spot on the final day.
concept: Meme of the Week slide: Phillies fans' heart rate monitor during the four-game skid vs. the final-day clinch
description: The Philadelphia Phillies beat the Tampa Bay Rays 7-3 on the final day of the regular season to clinch the NL's last wild-card spot, holding off the Arizona Diamondbacks after losing four straight.
headline: Phillies clinch final NL Wild Card spot on the last day
